summary: Implemented E3052, E3053 and E3054 as three keyword-triggered ECS rules with unit tests. Added src/cfnlint/rules/resources/ecs/ServiceNetworkConfiguration.py, TaskDefinitionAwsVpc.py and ServiceFargate.py, plus test/unit/rules/resources/ecs/test_service_network_configuration.py, test_task_definition_aws_vpc.py and test_service_fargate.py. All 82 ECS tests pass. The venv's cfnlint is an editable install from a different tree, so tests ran with PYTHONPATH set to this repo's src. Full test/unit: 1540 passed, 1 failed (test_build_graph, missing pygraphviz/pydot); test_formatters.py excluded (missing defusedxml). Integration: 14 passed, 4 failed (JUnit formatter and quickstart-template tests); none of the new IDs fire on the quickstart fixture, but the count mismatches were not confirmed against baseline. black and ruff are not in the venv, so formatting is unverified; line lengths were checked manually. Fixed during testing: E3053 path override leaking a NetworkMode segment, and shared path deques mutated across test cases. Nothing committed; a test-generated generic.yaml.dot artifact was removed.
